description: This file contains CMake functions and macros for configuring header-only libraries and packages, including generating configuration files and package config files, with logic for handling templates, dependencies, and installation paths.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a header-only library's CMake configuration files, handling dependencies, templates, and target properties.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a pkg-config file for a header-only package, including handling compile options, include directories, and dependencies.
